primary_ux_fallback.spec: Typical users open the app to view notes, with most sessions involving vertical scrolling through note lists or browsing individual notes. They often use horizontal swipes to navigate between tabs or sections within a note. Opening the 'Notes' tab first is recommended for optimal UX. Users may also occasionally tap on the '+' icon to create new notes.
